description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the DetailedLeaveRequest class in the OrangeHRM Leave module. It contains unit tests validating behavior and functionality of the DetailedLeaveRequest DTO, including fetching leave details, handling leave periods, and allowed actions. It sets up fixtures, mocks dependencies, and tests various scenarios related to leave requests.

classes.name: DetailedLeaveRequestTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for the DetailedLeaveRequest Data Transfer Object in the OrangeHRM Leave module. It tests leave request fetching, leave period handling, and allowed actions for different scenarios.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test fixtures by loading configuration data from a YAML fixture file.

methods.name: testEmptyLeaveRequest
methods.description: Tests behavior when an empty LeaveRequest object is used, expecting specific errors for uninitialized properties and empty leaves.

methods.name: testSingleDayLeaveRequest
methods.description: Validates leave details for a single-day leave request, checking date and duration details.

methods.name: testMultiDayLeaveRequestFirstDayHoliday
methods.description: Tests leave request with multiple days where the first day is a holiday, verifying allowed actions.

methods.name: testMultiStatusLeaveRequest
methods.description: Tests leave request with multiple statuses, checking for no allowed actions.

methods.name: setServices
methods.description: Configures mock user and registers necessary services for testing scenarios.

methods.name: testGetLeavePeriodsWithAssignedLeaveForPastLeavePeriod
methods.description: Tests fetching leave periods for a leave request with past leave periods, expecting an empty list.
